entries.failure_mode: Disease material ≠ healthy organ: using disease samples against healthy tissue composition as a 'benchmark' misreads material category
entries.observable_signature: Disease material composition naturally deviates from healthy baseline; comparisons outside the three-use protocol (identity reference/background control/QC flag) constitute misuse
entries.mitigation: Baseline for membrane samples has only three uses (identity reference/background control/QC flag); prohibited as benchmark; off-list identities trigger unexpected flag but retain original judgment; use PDR-specific prior (established) not healthy retina grid for comparison anchor.
